shortDescription: Manages UCS Scrub Policies on UCS Manager

options.name: bios_settings_scrub
options.description: Scrub the BIOS settings. If the field is set to Yes, when a service profile containing this scrub policy is disassociated from a server, the BIOS settings for that server are erased and reset to the defaults for that server type and vendor. If this field is set to No, the BIOS settings are preserved. yes scrub the BIOS settings. no do not scrub the BIOS settings.

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the organization. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote) = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), ' (single quote).

options.name: disk_scrub
options.description: Scrub the BIOS settings. If this field is set to Yes, when a service profile containing this scrub policy is disassociated from a server, all data on the server local drives is completely erased. If this field is set to No, the data on the local drives is preserved, including all local storage configuration. yes scrub the server disks. no do not scrub the server disks.

options.name: flex_flash_scrub
options.description: Scrub the BIOS settings. If the field is set to Yes, the HV partition on the SD card is formatted using the PNUOS formatting utility when the server is reacknowledged. If this field is set to No, the SD card is preserved. yes scrub the flex flash. no do not scrub the flex flash.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the organization. Enter up to 16 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote) = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), ' (single quote).

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: persistent_memory_scrub
options.description: Scrub the BIOS settings. If the field is set to Yes, when a service profile containing this scrub policy is disassociated from a server, all persistent memory modules for that server are erased and reset to the defaults for that server type and vendor. If this field is set to No, the persistent memory modules are preserved. yes scrub the persistent memory. no do not scrub the persistent memory.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(absent), will remove organization. If C(present), will create or update organization.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
